profile.name: Hands at Work
profile.summary: A workshop identity that joins an expressive serif invitation to a clear sequence of making and practical attendance details.
profile.decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.

typography.usage: Source CSS alias WorkshopSerif resolves to fonts/tinos/Tinos-Bold.ttf; workshop titles.
Source alias WorkshopSans resolves to the Arimo regular and bold WOFF2 files; instructions and practical detail.

recognitionRules: Pair the workshop serif display face with the source sans-serif body.
Use forest ink on cream, with rust reserved for the primary action.
Number the workshop stages and give each a title and short description.
Keep materials, access and attendance facts together below the invitation.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Start with a simple material. Make something you can hold.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

profile.logoDirection: Use HANDS AT WORK as a serif wordmark with a short underline ending before the final letter. No hand illustration or craft-tool cluster.
invariants: Pair the workshop serif display face with the source sans-serif body.
Use forest ink on cream, with rust reserved for the primary action.
Number the workshop stages and give each a title and short description.
adaptations: A poster keeps invitation, date and one action.
A participant sheet expands the numbered stages and removes promotional language.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

source.nameStatus: Editorial name derived for this reusable identity; source specimen names remain fictional.
source.observationBoundary: Source values and component names are observed; identity naming, verbal examples and reusable rules are editorial design choices. Rendered application QA is tracked separately.

visualFidelityReview.scope: Native rendered cover/desktop preview reviewed on 104-identity contact boards; discrepancies opened individually. Native XML corroborates exact values. This does not claim every page was visually inspected.
visualFidelityReview.logoBoundary: The authored brand wordmark and symbol are new editorial proposals unless separately identified as preserved source geometry; supporting native artwork and functional color roles are not replaced by the new logo.

rights.identity: Original editorial identity for a fictional template-derived system; names are not trademark-cleared.
rights.fonts: Family names identify source typography; redistribution requires font-specific license evidence. A system-installed font is not a redistributable asset.
rights.assets: Use only local source assets with recorded permission; no external brands or reference-kit identities are included.

profile.recognitionRulesStatus: Editorial translation of source mechanisms. Exact source observations are recorded separately; final applications require rendered review.
profile.logoDirectionStatus: New design direction, not proof of a finished, trademark-cleared or approved logo.

accessibility.scope: Calculated solid-color reading pair only. Accent text, controls, image overlays, font rendering, small marks and final layouts require application-specific review. Decorative palette colors are not automatically valid text colors.

logoProduction.decision: Use HANDS AT WORK as a serif wordmark with a short underline ending before the final letter. No hand illustration or craft-tool cluster.
logoProduction.productionMethod: outlined typography and identity-specific geometric construction
logoProduction.productionNotes: Self-contained SVG masters contain real paths. PNG exports are rendered at 2x with MuPDF. No raster is described as editable vector. Source family substitutions are explicit in fontsUsed and brand-font-plan.

typeDependency.status: resolved for logo assets; source family retained as provenance

clearSpace.rule: One lowercase x-height around the wordmark, including its shortened underline.
clearSpace.status: production rule for review; asset canvas padding is not the full application exclusion zone

minimumSize.status: Conservative production recommendation after inspection at primary220px, secondary180px and symbols32/64px. Trial Ledger record code and Orbit descriptor motivate larger full-lockup minima; use secondary in narrow spaces.

portableTypography.usage: Source CSS alias WorkshopSerif resolves to fonts/tinos/Tinos-Bold.ttf; workshop titles.
portableTypography.justification: Exact licensed source family for the source role. Exact OFL family present in the source template; regular and bold are assembled from its local source and official upstream Tinos release.

portableTypography.usage: Source alias WorkshopSans resolves to the Arimo regular and bold WOFF2 files; instructions and practical detail.
portableTypography.justification: Exact licensed source family for the source role. Arimo is available from verified open-font sources; for Arial roles it provides a metrics-compatible portable choice.

verification: Source records and asset provenance checked; rendered guide review is tracked separately in project evidence.
